note: Hand-written. Every expect.* value was set from contract.md (r3.1) sentences cited in 'basis', never by calling an implementation. A harness may only expand specs mechanically: fill defaults, turn offsets into RFC3339, copy definition fields from the contract §3 tables.

conventions.times: t/now/reset/valid_*/observed are seconds relative to T0 (fractional allowed)
conventions.received_at: own-machine observations: null (not uploaded); other-machine observations: t + 1 (hub-stored), unless the row sets received_at
conventions.vals: string = named set; object = {limit_id: [used_pct, reset_offset, window_instance?] | {used, reset, reset_str, instance, observed}}; key 'extend' merges onto a named set. claude window_instance defaults to "unknown"; ctest fixed defaults to the reset instant string; ctest.rolling_1d defaults to "unknown".
conventions.selected: list of observation ids with multiplicity (an id appears once per selected observation object)
conventions.codes: claude rows: final code after §6G; ctest rows: FRESH/STALE for the fresh/stale outcome (§6G note)
